headwords.gloss: i. q; May God preserve thee alive; prolong thy life; make thee to continue in life

parts.t: , (Mgh, Msb, K,) in its primary sense,
May God preserve thee alive; prolong thy life;
make thee to continue in life;
make thee to be free from evil,
may God make thee to have dominion:
may God honour thee, and benefit thee.

headwords.gloss: He made him alive, to live; be a living being; quickened, endued with life, vivified; revivified, revived

parts.t: He made him alive, to live,
be a living being; quickened, endued with life, vivified,
(S, * Msb, * K.) Hence, in the Kur [lxxv. last verse],
أَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ أَنْ يُحْيِىَ المَوْتَى
endued him with the intellectual faculty:
as in the saying, in the Kur [vi. 122],
And is he who was intellectually dead and whom we have endued with the intellectual faculty...?

headwords.def: احياهُ احياه احياة أحياه أحيى , (S, Msb, K, &c.,) inf. n. إِحْيَآءٌ , (TA,) said of God, (S, Msb,) He made him alive, to live, or be a living being; quickened, endued with life, vivified, [ revivified, revived, or resuscitated, ] him. (S, * Msb, * K.) Hence, in the Kur [lxxv. last verse], أَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ أَنْ يُحْيِىَ المَوْتَى , (S, TA,) i. e. Is not That Doer of these things (Jel) [ able to quicken the dead? ]. See also 2, in two places. (assumed tropical:) He (God) endued him with the intellectual faculty: as in the saying, in the Kur [vi. 122], أَوَمَنْ كَانَ مَيِّتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَاهُ (assumed tropical:) [ And is he who was intellectually dead and whom we have endued with the intellectual faculty...? ]. (Er-Rághib.) See also 3.

Also A salutation, or greeting, (A'Obeyd, AHeyth, Mgh, Msb,) pronounced by one person to another on their meeting; (AHeyth;) particularly the saying سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ ; (Mgh, * Msb;) and the like; (Mgh;) the most comprehensive form thereof, used by the believer [to his fellow-believer], being the saying السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ : (AHeyth:) hence it is pluralized; the pl. being تَحِيَّاتٌ and تَحَايَا . (Mgh.) Also Continuance, or endurance; or endless, or everlasting, existence: (IAar, Msb, K, &c.:) and so it is said to mean in the following verse of Zuheyr Ibn-Jenáb ElKelbee; who was a [kind of] king among his people: قَدْ نِلْتُهُ إِلَّا التَّحِيَّهْ

headwords.def: مُحَيًّا محيا The face (S, K, Ham p. 23) of a man, because it is specified in salutation; [see 2;] (Ham ubi suprá;) a term used only in praise; (Ham p. 640;) i. e. the face altogether: or the حُرّ of the face [i. e. the ball of the cheek; or what appears of the elevated part thereof; or what fronts one, of the face, &c.]. (K.) Of a horse, it is The place where the flesh is separated ( حيث انفرق اللحم ) beneath the forelock. (Ham p. 23.) And دَائِرَةُ المُحَيَّا , in a horse, [ The feather in ] the place of separation [ of the hair ] beneath the forelock, in the upper part of the forehead. (TA.)

headwords.def: محَيِّىٌ محيى محيي act. part. n. of 2; fem. مُحَيِّيَةٌ : (S, TA:) for in every noun in which three ى s occur together, [the last of them being the final radical, and ending the word,] if it is not formed from a verb, the final radical letter is elided from it, as in عُطَىٌّ the dim. of عَطَآءٌ , and in أُحَىُّ the dim. of أَحْوَى : but if it is formed from a verb, that letter remains, as in مُحَيِّىٌ from حَيَّى .
